title: The winter village
text: The Kawaiisu have made these mountains their home for two to three thousand years. One of their winter village sites, Tomo-Kahni, which is Kawaiisu for winter village, became a California state historic park in 1993, {distance} from here. The ground is treated as so fragile that it can be visited only on a guided tour.

s1.title: Tomo-Kahni State Historic Park
s1.quote: Tomo-Kahni, or 'Winter Village,' was the site of a Kawaiisu (Nuwa) village. ... The Kawaiisu migrated from the Great Basin and made the Tehachapi their home for two to three thousand years. ... Tomo-Kahni State Historic Park was created as a unit of California State Parks in 1993 to protect and preserve the integrity of this unique site. ... Due to the extremely sensitive nature of the site, Tomo-Kahni is available to the public by guided tour only.
